user.title: Add a Windows machine
user.description: The setup wizard on the Windows machine fills this in for you. To add a machine by hand, run `hass-toast --show-key` on it to read its signing key, and use the same device id the agent is configured with.

data_description.device_id: Must match the agent's device id exactly; it is how the agent recognises envelopes meant for it.
data_description.signing_key: The base64 key printed by --show-key. Envelopes are signed with it so no other component can forge toasts.

reconfigure.title: Replace the signing key
reconfigure.description: Paste the new key for {device_id}. Run `hass-toast --rotate-key` on that machine to generate one, then restart the agent so it picks up the change.

data_description.signing_key: The base64 key printed by --rotate-key. The device id cannot be changed here — a different machine is a new entry.

error.invalid_key: That is not a valid signing key. It should be the base64 value printed by `hass-toast --show-key`, decoding to 32 bytes.

abort.already_configured: That device id is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The signing key was replaced. Restart the agent on that machine if you have not already.
